We are on. We're rolling. This is April, 1975, talking with Horace Henderson in Denver, Colorado. Horace, actually, I'd like to get a little bit of biographical material. We have a certain amount that is available to us, but I think that one thing particularly interests me and all of us is basically, what got you involved in music and how old were you and what were you doing when you really first started in music?
